description: 雾蓝蜜金母婴风：防侧翻结构、静音轮、一键折叠、双模餐盘的成长型宝宝学步车

styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating flat misty-teal #B7D3D8 and cloud-grey #E9EBEC section panels on pure white #FFFFFF, flat pastel layouts with generous vertical rhythm
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright diffused studio light, soft front-left key, minimal soft shadows, clean airy mood
styleLock.surfaceSystem: flat seamless pastel studio backdrop; light oak wood floor for lifestyle scenes
styleLock.typography: modern rounded geometric sans-serif; mid-teal #7FB3B8 section kickers plus deep slate-teal #3F4A4D headlines; pill-shaped rounded label chips
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line circular outline icons in soft teal #9FC5CB, consistent 2px stroke, flat pictogram style
styleLock.presentationRules: product clean and centered at stable scale, hero angle kept consistent, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout, images set inside rounded rectangles or arch-shaped masks
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: soft pastel baby-gear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of misty teal #B7D3D8, cloud grey #E9EBEC and pure white #FFFFFF backgrounds, deep slate-teal text #3F4A4D, mid-teal kicker labels #7FB3B8, and one warm honey-gold accent #E9C46A; overall cool temperature warmed by the honey-gold accent; modern rounded geometric sans-serif typography with short headlines only; flat pastel section layouts composed as complete balanced panels with natural breathing margins; bright diffused studio lighting, soft front key, minimal soft shadows; thin-line circular outline icons in soft teal #9FC5CB with consistent 2px stroke; pill-shaped rounded label chips; product presented clean and centered at a stable scale inside rounded or arch-shaped image masks; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no dense body text.

provenance.notes: 基于 800x1200 详情页长图的 11 片切板（panel-01~11，60px 重叠）重制。产品身份由封面标题「宝宝学步车」及卖点文案（静音轮/防侧翻/餐盘/折叠/音乐）确认，与源文件名一致，按图面信息归类。taxonomy L2 选「出行」而非「玩具」：学步车属婴儿行走助动/移动器具，与推车同族；玩具属性（音乐玩具盘）仅是部件卖点。已剥离：源素材水印 logo、二维码会员贴片、店铺标语；源图数字主张（承重111斤、钢管壁厚1.0mm对比0.8mm）一律改写为 {selling_point}/{callout} 占位符，未写入任何不可证实事实；源图中不可验证的资质信任元素一律改为材质与做工等可验证视觉细节。
